No. At an altitude of **−6.883°**, the Moon is nearly **7° below your local horizon**, so Earth itself blocks it from view. Its 81.87% illumination, clear skies, and civil twilight do not change that.

You would have to wait until it rises; from that location and time, it is **physically impossible to see directly** with unaided eyes—or even a telescope—from ground level.
